name: Summer Teen Naturalist
what_you_do: Teens who love animals spend two weeks at the zoo. They do hands-on work and teach visitors about nature, and they spend time with the ambassador animals.
duration: 2 weeks, 6 days total, 10 am to 3 pm
deadline_text: The page says to check back for 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Register online through the Register Online link on the program page, or call 716-837-3900 to sign up. Questions: 716-995-6143.
notes: Written proof of a negative TB test is required before the program starts, per the page.
